calibration_framing.script: Step back until your full frame is inside the brackets—ears, shoulders, hips, and ankles.

calibration_locked.script: Locked in. Hold steady right there.

readiness_rep_1_3.script: Give me three smooth reps at your natural depth—rep one of three, nice and controlled.

tempo_3_1_1_eccentric.script: Three seconds down—three, two, one—pause at the bottom, drive up.

set_complete_great_work.script: Set locked. Clean work—breathe through your nose and let your heart rate settle.

rest_timer_10s_warning.script: Ten seconds—hands on the implements, tall ribcage.

desk_reset_transition.script: Nice release. Reset your posture and flow into the next mobility drill.

safety_pause_check.script: Pause right there—we never push through sharp or pinchy joint pain. Let's check in and protect that joint.
